item.title: About the Skills Challenge
item.description: AI Developer Challenge # Get a solid foundation in machine learning and AI concepts and related Microsoft Azure services. This learning journey is designed for participants with both technical and non-technical backgrounds. In this challenge, you’ll learn how to create no-code predictive models, explore computer vision, natural language processing, conversational AI and so much more. Complete the challenge in time and you will get a chance of winning one of the prizes!

item.title: Join the challenge
item.description: How do I start this challenge? # You will need to register for this challenge using your Microsoft Learn profile. Once the challenge begins, you will see the modules you will need to complete. If you don’t have a Microsoft Learn profile, that is okay. You can create a free account by selecting Create account from the login screen when joining the challenge. How do I complete this challenge? # To complete this challenge, you’ll need to finish the designated collection of Microsoft Learn content before the challenge end date.

item.title: Terms & Conditions
item.description: All eligible individuals who complete the 30-Day AI Developer Challenge will get a chance to win a 12-Month LinkedIn Premium voucher. The following terms and conditions apply. One (1) LinkedIn Premium voucher will be awarded per 10 participants. A minimum of 15 participants must complete the challenge. The vouchers will be raffled at random. Challenge participants earn one (1) incentive raffle submission for every 10 modules completed. Limit one (1) voucher per person.
